references.text: Jesus' knowledge of who would betray him, and his direct reference to Scripture, repeats the theme in 13:11 that he knew the one who would hand him over.
Here Jesus confirms that he knows who is not clean, pointing specifically to one of the twelve as a devil, which mirrors the claim in 13:11 that not all the disciples are clean.

In his solemn prayer, Jesus affirms that he kept those given to him, except for the one who would betray him, and that this happened so that Scripture might be fulfilled, linking it to the context of 13:11.
This psalm verse, which Jesus quoted in 13:18, describes a close friend who lifted his heel against him, providing the prophetic background for Jesus' knowledge of the betrayer in 13:11.
